description: This PHP source file defines the EfsClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with Amazon EFS (Elastic File System). It includes method annotations for various EFS operations, indicating the available API calls and their asynchronous variants.

classes.name: EfsClient
classes.description: The EfsClient class is used to perform various operations on Amazon EFS, such as creating and deleting file systems, access points, mount targets, and configurations. It extends the AwsClient class, inheriting shared AWS client functionalities.

methods.name: createAccessPoint
methods.description: Creates a new access point in Amazon EFS.

methods.name: createFileSystem
methods.description: Creates a new EFS file system.

methods.name: deleteFileSystem
methods.description: Deletes an existing EFS file system.

methods.name: describeFileSystems
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions of one or more EFS file systems.

methods.name: updateFileSystem
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing EFS file system.
